content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Conventional platforms like PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer rented infrastructure. You get a dashboard, payment processing, and product delivery—but only if you’re in an approved country. These platforms are not designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe. They’re built for markets where banking and currency systems are stable. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is self-owned. You deploy your stack on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. Payment processing is handled by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) gives you this entire architecture, deployed and tested in 48 hours. You own it. You control it. No platform can shut you down.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms exclude countries based on risk assessments, regulatory compliance, and currency volatility. Nigeria, Pakistan, and Venezuela are often blocked because these platforms prioritize their own legal and financial safety over your ability to sell. Even if you use a VPN or intermediary, your account can be frozen or terminated. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. Since you own the stack, there’s no central authority to block you. Your store runs on decentralized hosting, your payments are processed on-chain, and your files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators in regions where conventional platforms fail. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative built on infrastructure you own.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal and Stripe charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but they’re not available to you. Crypto payment processors like NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees or hidden costs. Transactions on networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. The real cost of conventional platforms isn’t just fees—it’s the loss of revenue when you can’t sell at all. Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates this risk. With the Edge Commerce Stack, payments are verified on-chain automatically, and files are delivered instantly. There’s no waiting for platform approval or worrying about account freezes. Your costs are predictable, and your revenue is yours to keep.
Conventional platforms exclude you. Sovereign infrastructure doesn’t.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to sell. If they shut down or change their terms, you’re locked out. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store is hosted on your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account. Your backend logic runs on your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Your orders are stored in your Supabase or Google Sheets database. File delivery is handled via your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account. The Edge Commerce Stack automates this entire process for you, so you can focus on creating. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your stack. You own it. You control it. You’re not renting—you’re building.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a country where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed for creators who need to sell globally without depending on platforms that exclude them. It’s deployed in 48 hours, includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability, and comes with 30-day support. If you’re selling ebooks, courses, or digital products and need full ownership and automation, this is your architecture. Conventional platforms are not an option—they’re a dead end. Sovereign infrastructure is the base layer you need to build a global business that can’t be shut down.
